Sales for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥34.5 billion, up 0.4% from the previous year. Demand for raw material enzymes for diagnostic agents was firm, but sales of diagnostic reagents were sluggish due to market conditions in China. Hollow fiber membranes for artificial kidneys were firm, but the startup of a new plant was delayed. In contract manufacturing of pharmaceuticals, profit improved due to revisions to product prices.

entries.8d56ab12542f6d98: This business manufactures and sells engineering plastics, industrial adhesives, optical functional materials, aqua membranes, functional filters, super fibers, nonwoven fabrics and others. Sales for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥110.1 billion, down 0.6% from the previous year. Engineering plastics for automotive use increased, and sales of the industrial adhesive “Bairon” also rose. On the other hand, as the EV market slowed, shipments of VOC recovery equipment used in the manufacturing process of lithium-ion batteries decreased. From April 2023, the business has been operated by Toyobo MC Co., Ltd., a joint venture with Mitsubishi Corporation.

entries.fec3c247e480d969: This business manufactures and sells packaging film and industrial film, and is the reportable segment with the largest sales. Sales for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥175.2 billion, up 5.0% from the previous year. In industrial applications, release film for ceramic capacitors grew, mainly for AI servers, and the liquid crystal polarizer protective film “COSMOSHINE SRF” was also firm. In packaging, shipment volumes were sluggish due to soaring food prices, but profit improved as productivity of new equipment rose.
